_note: B-63. Software install request on the mock tenant state, from the approved catalog only (fixtures/catalog/approved-software.json; a test keeps the package_id enum equal to the catalog ids). Mock only; no RMM is called and nothing installs. Update proposals come from levers.python.software.propose_updates and are dry-run calls of this lever.

levers.name: device.install-app
levers.description: Ask for one approved-catalog package, at the version and hash the catalog pins, to be installed on one device of the client. Mock of an RMM software deployment; records a request in the client's own state.

device_uid.description: RMM device uid of one device of the client

package_id.description: Catalog id of the package; only ids of the approved catalog pass, and only if the client approved it

impact.L1: The person gets the app they need from the vetted list, not from an installer they found; an install can slow their PC for a few minutes.
impact.L2: Only software the client approved, at a pinned version and hash, reaches its devices; a wrong time can interrupt a working PC in the office.
impact.L3: Each software request is one approved, audited change per device and package however often it is asked, so the MSP can show what was installed.
impact.L4: A request names one client's own device and that client's approved catalog only, so one office's software list is never applied to another's.
